tool: backend/scripts/discover_datasets.py (read-only; nothing is downloaded by the survey)
how_to_read: The survey returned 970 candidates; 741 carry a permissive publisher licence and 426 of those have a relevant word in the title. Almost all are supplementary files of papers, genomics, EEG, or non-image data. Each candidate whose title suggests images for a task this project lacks data for (acne, pigmentation, redness, scarring, texture, hair, scalp) or a general dermatology image set was opened and read; those are listed below with the verdict and its reason. A publisher's licence statement is only a claim: it passes the registry's licence gate only after the official terms are read, evidenced and approved, and a re-upload never inherits more rights than the original has.

reviewed.title: DERM12345: a large, multisource dermatoscopic skin lesion dataset with 40 subclasses
reviewed.reason: Original authors' deposit; licence read from the repository record; every image row also carries copyright-license CC-BY. 4,821 images selected (the 2,500-image cap on benign nevi keeps the class balance sane).
reviewed.used_for: dermoscopy_lesion_research (external validation and second training set)

reviewed.title: ISIC Archive: dermoscopic and clinical images with contributor licence CC-0 or CC-BY only
reviewed.publisher_licence: per image: CC-0 / CC-BY (a CC-BY-NC pool exists and is never listed)
reviewed.reason: The archive as a whole is refused (mixed licences). Two licence-filtered subsets are registered and approved: dermoscopic images (11,974 official 256 px thumbnails) and clinical photographs (474 full-size images; the 2,298 images attributed to the Federal University of Espirito Santo are PAD-UFES-20 itself and are excluded).

reviewed.title: SCIN: Skin Condition Image Network
reviewed.publisher_licence: SCIN Data Use License (attribution; no re-identification; no non-commercial clause)
reviewed.reason: Licence text read in full from the official repository. Self-submitted photographs with dermatologist labels; 2,842 images of 11 conditions that each have at least 40 qualifying cases.

reviewed.title: SCIN-Dermatology-Raw-Images
reviewed.reason: A third-party curated copy of SCIN (its card says so) under an MIT label; an uploader cannot grant rights that SCIN's own licence does not grant, so the official source and its licence are used.

reviewed.title: Raw HAM10000 dataset
reviewed.reason: A copy of HAM10000, whose rights holder (Harvard Dataverse record of the original authors) states CC BY-NC 4.0; an uploader who is not the rights holder cannot relicense it.

reviewed.title: FitzDerm-CF: a controlled multimodal dermatology resource for skin-tone counterfactual and leakage evaluation
reviewed.reason: Its own description says it augments images from Fitzpatrick17k and DDI with synthetic notes; those two datasets are non-commercial, so the CC0 label on the derived package cannot be relied on.

reviewed.title: Binary_Skin_Cancer_Dataset
reviewed.reason: 6,482 dermoscopic images 'curated from publicly available dermatology image sources' with no named source or per-image licence: the rights cannot be traced.

reviewed.title: Curated Skin Disease Dataset for Ringworm, Scabies, and Normal Human Skin Classification
reviewed.reason: 2,100 images 'collected from multiple publicly available sources' with no named sources, and the description itself says the set is intended for non-commercial research.

reviewed.title: huynhnhu213/acne
reviewed.reason: The dataset card is only a licence header: no source of the images, no description of the labels, no consent statement. The only acne image set found in the survey, and its provenance cannot be established.

reviewed.title: Skin Tone Matching LoRA Training Dataset
reviewed.reason: 98 image pairs for training an inpainting model; no labels for any task in this project.

reviewed.title: ScalpHairLabels v1: hand annotations of hair shafts and follicular openings on public-domain scalp dermoscopy
reviewed.reason: The only lead for the hair and scalp tasks. 504 tiles cut from 108 CC-0 ISIC scalp dermoscopy images with binary hair masks and 1,101 follicular-opening points: a segmentation dataset for measuring hair shafts, far too small for a model, with no hair-loss grade and no scalp-condition label, so it cannot support `hair_thinning` or `scalp_findings`.

reviewed.title: DermArtifactDB: a multi-label dataset for artifact annotation in public dermoscopic image repositories
reviewed.reason: Annotations of hair, rulers, ink and similar artefacts on ISIC-2019, PH2 and Derm7pt images (repositories with mixed licences); no diagnosis or condition labels.

reviewed.title: First set of facial skin images (PURE dataset)
reviewed.reason: Facial video frames for pulse estimation; no skin-condition labels.

reviewed.title: AI-generated synthetic dataset with face images of skin disease patients
reviewed.reason: Images generated by DALL-E 3: they say nothing about real skin and would invalidate any evaluation.

reviewed.title: Psoriasis and Eczema dataset
reviewed.reason: A 0.7 MB archive of study data, not images.

reviewed.title: Skin Cancer Diagnostics with an All-Inclusive Smartphone Application
reviewed.reason: One sample photograph and a paper.

reviewed.title: HAM10000
reviewed.reason: Non-commercial licence from the original publisher.

reviewed.title: Fitzpatrick 17k
reviewed.reason: Non-commercial, share-alike; the images belong to the websites they were taken from.

reviewed.title: Diverse Dermatology Images
reviewed.reason: Registration-gated; commercial use needs a separate licence.

reviewed.title: ACNE04
reviewed.reason: No licence in the authors' repository; consent for the face images is undocumented; written permission from the authors would be needed.

result_for_the_blocked_tasks: No candidate with traceable rights and task-matched labels exists for acne, pigmentation, redness, dryness/scaling, texture/scarring, hair thinning or scalp findings. Those tasks stay unavailable; what would unblock them is in docs/PHASE_5_TRAINING_REPORT.md.
